line: Commander, on your feet! A Hive swarm just dropped out of the dark, right across the convoy's course.
They don't take prisoners and they don't bargain. Every gun we have: weapons free!
The swarm is broken. We held, Commander.
That swarm answered to Vael'Khor, the Hive Matriarch. She devours whole worlds, and now she knows our name.
It cost us dearly, and our reactors were nearly dry. We set down on the nearest world we could reach.
Commander. We made it, barely. The convoy is gone, and this world is all we have left.
Every planet here orbits the Void, a black hole at the heart of the galaxy. The Hive holds most of them.
We're not alone either. Other commanders orbit the Void, and any colony can change hands.
Now we rebuild, and we grow strong enough to end Vael'Khor. I'll post directives on the Base tab. Complete them and Fleet Command will send supplies.

where: Academy step 1: Choose your commander name
line: First things first, Commander: what should the galaxy call you? Every commander sees this name. Type it and tap Save.
This world is ours now. Give our capital a name worthy of an empire, then tap Save.

where: Academy step 3: Build a Metal Extractor
line: Everything starts with metal. Open Structures and build your first Metal Extractor.

where: Academy step 4: Build a Solar Array
line: Extractors need power. A Solar Array keeps them running at full speed.

where: Academy step 5: Build a Crystal Refinery
line: Crystal pays for research and better hulls. Get a refinery going.

where: Academy step 6: Upgrade the Metal Extractor to Lv.2
line: Upgrades multiply your income. Jobs under five minutes finish for free: tap Free when it appears.

where: Academy step 7: Build a Gas Synthesizer
line: Drones, ships and research all burn gas. Get a synthesizer running.
Drone Works speeds up every construction and unlocks the Shipyard. You'll find it under Facility.
No fleet, no empire. Build the Shipyard.

where: Academy step 10: Build the Research Center
line: Ships need engines, and engines need research. Build a Research Center under Facility.
Energy Technology is the root of the tech tree, and Combustion Drive needs it. Start it now.
Combustion Drive powers your first warships. Once it is done, the Shipyard can build Light Fighters.
Light Fighters are cheap and fast: perfect for your first raids. Queue three of them. Academy crews build them in a minute each.

where: Academy step 14: Attack a Hive garrison
line: The amber worlds belong to Vael'Khor's Hive. I've marked a weak garrison near us: send the fighters and show her we bite back.

where: Academy step 15: Tap your fleet on the map
line: Our fighters are under way. Find them on the Galaxy map and tap them: the camera follows your fleet and its control bar opens.
Every minute in transit is a minute the Hive digs in. Tap ⚡ to light the afterburners: the rest of the trip is 50% faster. This first burn is on the Academy.

where: Academy step 17: Watch it in cinematic view
line: Now sit back, Commander. Tap 🎥 and the camera rides in with your fighters, right into the fight.

where: Academy step 18: Defeat a Hive garrison
line: Our fighters are closing on the garrison. Win the fight and the report lands in Mail. If they lost, send them again.

where: Academy step 19: Gather from a resource field
line: Resource fields pay out to whoever holds them. Fields already held by a rival must be fought for, so pick a free one.

where: Academy step 20: Explore a pyramid space station
line: Derelict pyramid stations drift all over the map. Low-level vaults are unguarded: free shards and relics.

where: Academy step 21: Read your reports in Mail
line: Every battle, espionage report and message lands in Mail. Replays show you exactly why you won or lost.

where: Academy step 22: Raid a Lv.5 pirate hideout
line: Pirates hoard loot and drop rare items. This first crew is a small one: send every fighter you have.

where: Academy step 23: Upgrade the Crystal Refinery to Lv.5
line: Crystal is the rarest thing we mine, and research runs on it. Take the Crystal Refinery to Lv.5: every level digs faster. The Academy covers the cost.

where: Academy step 24: Upgrade the Research Center to Lv.3
line: Next goal: a second world. Astrophysics decides how many planets we can hold, and it needs Research Center Lv.3, Espionage Technology Lv.4 and Impulse Drive Lv.3. Start with the Research Center.

where: Academy step 25: Research Impulse Drive to Lv.3
line: Impulse Drive speeds up Colony Ships and heavier hulls, and Astrophysics needs Lv.3. Find it under Engine Research.

where: Academy step 26: Research Espionage Technology to Lv.4
line: Better probes, and the last thing Astrophysics needs. Take Espionage Technology to Lv.4 under Advanced Research.
Everything is in place. Start Astrophysics under Advanced Research: it charts stable orbits for settlers.
One more level and we can hold a second world. Every 2 levels of Astrophysics adds a planet, up to 10.
Never attack blind. Espionage Probes fly in, count the defenders and come home with a report. They need Shipyard Lv.3 and Espionage Technology Lv.2.

where: Academy step 30: Spy on a Hive world
line: I've marked the weakest Hive world near us. Tap Espionage on its card and send your probes.

where: Academy step 31: Read the espionage report
line: The probes are back. Open the report in Mail: it shows the defenders, their ships and the resources you could take home.

where: Academy step 32: Attack the world you scouted
line: Now we know what's there. Send a fleet that outguns its garrison: the report shows exactly what you're up against.

where: Academy step 33: Build a Colony Ship
line: Astrophysics Lv.2 lets us hold a second world. A Colony Ship needs Shipyard Lv.4 and Impulse Drive Lv.3.

where: Academy step 34: Settle your first colony
line: Send the Colony Ship along with your warships to a Hive world you can beat. Win the battle and the world becomes ours: our second planet, and the first world we take back from Vael'Khor.

where: Academy step 35: Raid pirates for flagship materials
line: Our flagship is built from rare materials, and pirates hoard them. Raid another hideout: what they drop goes to the Flagship Dock. After that, the Academy clears you to build the Dock.

where: Academy step 36: Build the Flagship Dock
line: The Flagship Dock is where our flagship is commissioned and where its gear is forged. Find it under Structures → Facility.
Everything's ready, Commander. Commission the flagship: from now on it leads every fleet we send, gains experience and wears the gear the Dock forges.
Clean work, Commander. That garrison won't trouble us for a while.
Vael'Khor felt that. Once your Academy training is done, expect her raiders over our homeworld.
Build defenses and keep some ships at home. Chapter 2: Hold the Line.
The worlds nearer the Void are richer, and the Hive guards them harder.
Check the tech tree in Research. Heavier hulls need lasers, ion and hyperspace tech. Chapter 3: Into the Reach.
Scouts found Hive breeding grounds along the event rim. Leviathans guard them.
Plasma weapons and Reapers will break them. Chapter 4: Breaking the Hive.
That's the Academy done, Commander. Our flagship leads the fleet now: it earns experience in every fight, and the Flagship Dock forges its gear.
Every 2 Astrophysics levels lets us hold another world: build more Colony Ships and send them with escorts to Hive worlds we can beat. I'll keep pointing you at the next directive on your path.
And Commander: Fleet Command's supply convoy lands in 8 hours. Come back then and claim it on the Quests tab.
